thread:
anya: Quick sync — Acme just asked for a private onramp (PII+KMS). They want a pilot in ~6 weeks. Need runtime/infra/security alignment on scope and launch criteria. Who can own sequencing?
leo: Can we trim scope to MVP: VPC peering + KMS + audit logs + single-customer canary? Otherwise runtime work explodes.
maria: Infra note: VPC + peering is straightforward, private control plane + deploy packaging is the heavy lift. Estimate: 3 sprints if we assume no extra headcount. With a sprint or two of ops support we can compress.
sam: Security guardrails: must have threat model, KMS key management plan, audit logs to SIEM, and a pen-test gating. We can't ship without an HLD and checklist signed off.
anya: Understood. Customer is flexible but prefers faster pilot. Proposed trade: reduce SLA for pilot (no failover, single region) to hit 6w. Acceptable?
leo: Runtime can do a reduced-cost variant — smaller model quantized, dedicated small GPU pool, limited concurrency — that lowers infra needs. But we need a concrete p95 goal for rollout gating.
maria: If pilot can tolerate degraded latency SLO (p95 <= 500ms best-effort) and no cross-region HA, infra can deliver in ~6 weeks with an engineer swing. Otherwise it's 10+ weeks.
sam: 500ms p95 best-effort is OK for pilot, but pen-test and audit log ingestion must be in scope. I'll need a list of data flows and encryption knobs.
noah: EngSRE: will need a canary plan + runbook, alerting thresholds, and rollback playbook. Add ~2 days for canary automation once infra is ready.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: reminder — please attach rollout doc to the release checklist: /release-checklists/private-onramp-pilot.md
anya: Decision proposal: Pilot scope = VPC peering + KMS integration + audit logs + HLD + pen-test gating, runtime limited to quantized model and low concurrency, pilot SLA relaxed (single-region, p95 <= 500ms best-effort). Canary = 1 customer, staged traffic.
leo: I can draft runtime plan + perf estimate by Wed EOD. Will include GPU-hour estimate and model variant.
maria: I'll draft infra tasks and a compressed timeline. Will call out extra headcount needed to hit 6w.
sam: I'll produce the security gating checklist + initial threat model by Tue. Will list required artifacts for sign-off.
noah: I'll own canary runbook and alert thresholds, will slot automation after infra tasks.
anya: Action items (add to doc): 1) Leo runtime plan (Wed), 2) Maria infra tasks + estimate (Thu), 3) Sam security checklist (Tue), 4) Noah canary/runbook (Thu), 5) Product: finalize pilot acceptance criteria and customer comms (Fri). Link: https://redwood.internal/docs/private-onramp/pilot-plan 
leo: small ask — can product commit to a single point of contact at Acme for integration? saves back-and-forth.
anya: I'll get them to commit.
maria: FYI — if we need dedicated GPUs in the region, procurement lead time might push beyond 6w. Flagging as high risk.
sam: Also flag compliance review for customer contracts (DPA) — legal needs heads-up.
anya: Noted. I'll loop in legal and customer success.
noah: I'll add the runbook template to the doc and link monitoring dashboards.
anya: Ok. Please drop blockers into the doc and react with :thumbsup: when you acknowledge your action. We'll do a short sync Fri to confirm status.
leo: :thumbsup:
maria: :thumbsup:
sam: :thumbsup:
noah: :thumbsup:
